text.what: A charitable hospital founded in 1443 that has been given vineyard land for five and a half centuries and sells the wine at auction every November to pay for the medicine.
text.story: Nicolas Rolin, chancellor to Philip the Good, and his wife Guigone de Salins built the Hôtel-Dieu with its tiled roof. Donors have left vines to it ever since, and the cuvées carry the donors' names.

kin.as: Where nearly all its vines sit.
